# LOGIC ERP

> > LOGIC ERP is India's comprehensive cloud-based ERP and POS software for retail, distribution, and manufacturing businesses with GST compliance, payment integration, and omnichannel support.

LOGIC ERP 2.0 serves pharmacies, supermarkets, fashion retailers, and manufacturers across India with integrated solutions for billing, inventory management, loyalty programs, and supply chain automation. The platform integrates with payment gateways like PayTM, PayU, Pine Lab, and CRM systems like Xeno and Unicommerce.

## Key Topics

- LOGIC ERP 2.0
- GST Compliance
- POS Software
- Inventory Management
- Retail Management
- ERP Software
- Multi-Store Management
- Omnichannel Retail
- Payment Integration (PayTM, PayU, Pine Lab)
- Loyalty Programs
- Supply Chain Management
- Home Delivery
- Accounting & Finance
- Unicommerce & Browntape Integration
- E-Way Bill Compliance
